blocks.content: **てから** expresses a strict sequence: action A must be fully completed before action B can begin. The completion of A is what makes B possible or appropriate.

rows.japanese: 手を洗ってから、食べます。
rows.english: I eat after washing my hands.

rows.japanese: 宿題をしてから、ゲームをします。
rows.romaji: Shukudai wo shite kara, gēmu wo shimasu.
rows.english: I play games after doing homework.

rows.japanese: 大学を卒業してから、働き始めました。
rows.romaji: Daigaku wo sotsugyō shite kara, hataraki hajimemashita.
rows.english: I started working after graduating from university.

rows.japanese: シャワーを浴びてから、寝ます。
rows.english: I sleep after taking a shower.

left.label: てから
left.description: A must be fully done before B. Completion is required : the sequence is strict.
left.example_jp: 食べてから、歯を磨きます。
left.example_en: I brush my teeth after eating.

right.label: 後で
right.description: "Later, after A" : B happens sometime after, with no strict completion implied.
